notes: The copula of *where is the garrison* is given to the fused `אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם` unit because `שָׁם` is the verbless clause's predicate (rule 20); giving it to `נְצִיב` was the competing reading.
The frame's *that* (t032) stands at the head of the apodosis, so the apodosis waw carries it under rule 45; the `כְּ` keeps the *when* of the temporal clause under rule 52.
